description: Retrieve a user's two-factor status.  This can be used to see if a user will need to complete a two-factor challenge to complete a login, and optionally identify the state of the two-factor trust across various applications. This operation provides more payload options than retrieveTwoFactorStatus.

requestBody.description: Check the status of two-factor authentication for a user, with more options than on a GET request.

action.description: Communicate various actionscontexts in which multi-factor authentication can be used.

eventInfo.description: Information about a user event (login, register, etc) that helps identify the source of the event (location, device type, OS, etc).

location.description: Location information. Useful for IP addresses and other displayable data objects.

name: retrieveTwoFactorStatusWithRequestWithId
